comment: Security advisories of eFa-next. Published signed with each release at https://repo.efa-next.eu/advisories/advisories.json (detached signature advisories.json.sig, repository key 1823D6D3BB7D5AEA286E836DCFE7E07916CC8046); the CVE watch of every host reads it. fixed: [epoch, version, release] of the first package with the fix; the release without the platform part (1, not 1.el9), so one entry fits EL9 and EL10 (1.el9 and 1.el10 both count as newer than 1).

advisories.summary: Web interface: multipart form bodies were parsed before a login without a limit on their parts (Werkzeug 2.0 of EL9); a client could tie up memory and CPU.
The rspamd repository file named http for packages and key; dnf could take a new key unasked. It is used only over https now.
An update of a set-up host without /etc/eFa-Version ran the first-install steps, which replaced its nginx, rspamd and Postfix settings.
